lines.text: Many learners say: I cut a ticket for the train.
Better: I bought a ticket for the train.
Bought! I bought a ticket for the game.

data.wrong: I cut a ticket for the train.
data.right: I bought a ticket for the train.

quiz.stem: I ___ a ticket for the game.

native.tip: نقول «قطعت تذكرة»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول buy a ticket: “I bought a ticket for the train.” وليس “I cut a ticket for the train.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I cut a ticket for the train.” 😅 نقول «قطعت تذكرة»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول buy a ticket، فالجملة الصحيحة “I bought a ticket for the train.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “bought” — نقول «قطعت تذكرة»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول buy a ticket. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we say «قطعت تذكرة», but in English we say buy a ticket: “I bought a ticket for the train.” not “I cut a ticket for the train.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I cut a ticket for the train.” 😅 In Arabic we say «قطعت تذكرة», but in English we say buy a ticket, so the right sentence is “I bought a ticket for the train.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
